verdict.rationale: JumpCloud's own documentation shows device management in the same platform as identity: unified cross-OS MDM and devices consolidated with identities into one source of truth. Device-compliance-driven access revocation covers policy enforcement tied to identity, and community users confirm they use its MDM across Mac, Windows and Linux. The evidence never explicitly documents enrollment flows or remote lock/wipe, so only part of the story is shown. Missing for 10: documented device enrollment workflow, explicit remote lock/wipe capability, detailed policy-enforcement docs.

support.subject: As an IT admin, devices are managed from the same platform or a documented MDM integration — enrollment, policy enforcement, and remote lock/wipe tied to identity

citations.quote: Manage, configure, secure, and support endpoint and server infrastructure across Windows, Linux, macOS, iOS, iPadOS, and Android.
Consolidate all identities—human, machine, and agent—secure access, and device management into one automated source of truth.
if a device falls out of compliance, access is revoked instantly—no manual intervention required
The biggest selling point for us has been their ability to support Mac, Windows, and Linux with a single pane of glass.
